probe_plan.description: Launch 2048 single-thread blocks. Each block reads its SM ID using inline PTX: asm volatile("mov.u32 %%0, %%%%smid;" : "=r"(smid)). Store all SM IDs to a device array. Copy back to host, count unique values. Repeat 5 times, take maximum unique count. Do NOT use cudaGetDeviceProperties.

Allocate 256MB float array on device. Launch kernel where each thread reads sequential floats with stride. Use cudaEvent for timing. Run 20 trials, take best (minimum) time. BW = 256MB / best_time_seconds. Use const float* __restrict__ for reads. Do NOT use volatile or float4 (volatile float4 causes copy constructor errors with nvcc).

Allocate 256MB float array on device. Launch kernel where each thread writes 1.0f to sequential positions with stride. Use cudaEvent for timing. Run 20 trials, take best (minimum) time. BW = 256MB / best_time_seconds.

Use popen() to run: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=clocks.max.graphics --format=csv,noheader,nounits. Parse the output as double (MHz), multiply by 1000 to get kHz. Print RESULT:device__attribute_max_gpu_frequency_khz=<value>. This is a simple C program with #include <stdio.h> and <stdlib.h>. Include cuda_runtime.h for nvcc compatibility but no CUDA kernels needed.

Use popen() to run: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=clocks.max.memory --format=csv,noheader,nounits. Parse the output as double (MHz), multiply by 1000 to get kHz. If that fails, try clocks.current.memory as fallback. This is a simple C program with #include <stdio.h> and <stdlib.h>.

Call cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&value, cudaDevAttrGlobalMemoryBusWidth, 0) to get the memory bus width in bits. This is a simple program: #include <stdio.h> and <cuda_runtime.h>. Call cudaDeviceGetAttribute, then printf RESULT:device__attribute_fb_bus_width=<value>. Do NOT use cudaGetDeviceProperties. cudaDeviceGetAttribute is allowed.

Launch FMA-heavy kernel: each thread runs 8 independent FMA chains for 1M iterations. Total ops = BLOCKS*THREADS*8*ITERS*2. Time with cudaEvent. achieved_tflops = total_ops / best_time_sec / 1e12. RTX 3090 peak = 35.58 TFLOPS. pct = achieved/peak*100. Cap at 99.9.

Allocate 512MB on device. Launch streaming read kernel (each thread reads sequential floats with stride, accumulates sum). Time with cudaEvent. achieved_bw = 512MB / best_time_sec. RTX 3090 peak BW = 936.2 GB/s. pct = achieved_bw / peak_bw * 100. Cap at 99.9. Use const float* __restrict__ src. Do NOT use volatile float4.
